coordinates.origin: Ground-plane placement point between left/right foot supports; Z=0. Mean paw-center Y=-0.035 m relative to root, an explicit small fore-aft placement offset.

concept.reason: Published actual skull figure4 and composite reconstruction figure10 inspected; no extra concept images needed.

scope: Complete robust multituberculate with broad rodent-like head, enlarged incisors and heavy grinding jaws. Not a rodent/beaver or isolated skull.

scale.basis: 2021 Table5 DMNH EPV.95284; authors caution measurements >50mm are rounded estimates because of deformation/breakage. 153.3mm cranial size is geometric mean, NOT skull length. AMNH16321 length159mm,width155mm,cranialsize157mm.
scale.whole_body_status: Conservative artistic reconstruction dimensions; no complete articulated skeleton supports exact whole length.
scale.soft_tissue_note: Reference dimensions constrain broad cranial proportions, not an exact fossil surface fit. External soft-tissue head is larger than the bony skull. Head/body/shoulder values are design estimates; exact exported bounds are recorded in technical evidence.

diagnostic_targets: Broad blocky head, large cheek/jaw mass and relatively short wide muzzle; cranial width nearly matches skull length rather than slender mouse muzzle.
Prominent paired gnawing incisors with controlled modest exposure; no canine fangs or giant tusks. Heavy rounded cheek mass should imply grinding jaws.
Four robust ground-supporting limbs and compact heavy trunk, low but not belly-dragging stance.
Plain tapered cylindrical tail, NEVER flat beaver paddle, webbed feet or arboreal squirrel bush.
Small rounded ears and lateral eyes, neutral coat. No armor, horns, patterned fur or insectivore snout.
Skull/head silhouette dominates identity; robust limbs distinguish from recently built Fruitafossor small gracile hindquarters.
uncertainties: 2025 original postcranial study assigns robust ulna/radius/femur/calcaneus but acknowledges incomplete skeleton; ground-dwelling inferred, digging only possible not established.
Exact torso, tail, digits and soft tissue proportions not fossil-established; conservative reconstruction only.
Fur color and ears speculative. Do not conflate multituberculate with modern Rodentia.
2021 composite skull drawing combines several fossils; not one complete exact specimen scan.
acceptance_checklist: Whole animal original scope preserved with broad head and incisors.
Broad skull/jaw shape matches current2021 reconstruction, not obsolete plaster-heavy AMNH mount alone.
Robust quadruped, nonpaddle tail, no aquatic claims.
Default4 exactGLB views, pinned local deps and two rebuilds; independentQA separate.
surface_profile: palette-only; flat normals, six opaque portable PBR colors, no textures
parameter_policy: Morphological targets document this frozen reconstruction; anatomical ring coordinates are explicitly authored in generate.py. Palette, seed and geometry budgets are read from params.json.
